plugin.name: swayfire-next
plugin._long: Sway-style tiling with Hyprland-style atomic fullscreen for Wayfire.

option.name: tile_by_default
option._long: Matcher expression deciding which views are tiled automatically.

option.name: key_focus_left
option._long: Move focus to the adjacent view on the left.

option.name: key_focus_right
option._long: Move focus to the adjacent view on the right.

option.name: key_focus_up
option._long: Move focus to the adjacent view above.

option.name: key_focus_down
option._long: Move focus to the adjacent view below.

option.name: key_toggle_fullscreen
option._long: Toggle fullscreen for the focused tiled view.

option.name: key_toggle_tiled
option._long: Toggle tiled/floating state of the focused view.
